project.name: Checkout Revamp
project.description: Replace legacy checkout with a modular payment flow, address validation, and staged rollout.

tasks.label: Scope checkout flow
tasks.description:
Problem: checkout spans three services with inconsistent error handling.
Action Items:
- Map current payment + shipping touchpoints
- Identify blockers for gateway swap
References: Scope: Checkout Revamp

tasks.label: Payment gateway integration
tasks.description:
Problem: Stripe Elements must replace the legacy iframe without breaking saved cards.
Action Items:
- Implement PaymentIntent lifecycle
- Wire webhook reconciliation
References: Design: Payment flow

tasks.label: Address validation
tasks.description:
Problem: international addresses fail silently at tax calculation.
Action Items:
- Integrate Loqate autocomplete
- Normalize country/state codes before totals
References: Investigation: Address validation

tasks.label: Cart totals audit
tasks.description:
Problem: promo stacking can double-apply percentage discounts.
Action Items:
- Add invariant tests for discount ordering
- Log mismatches to observability
References: Scope: Checkout Revamp

tasks.label: Feature flag rollout
tasks.description:
Problem: we need a safe ramp from 1% to 100% with instant rollback.
Action Items:
- Add checkout_v2 flag with cohort rules
- Dashboard for conversion delta
References: Payment gateway integration, Cart totals audit

tasks.label: E2E checkout tests
tasks.description:
Problem: regressions slip through when gateway mocks drift from production.
Action Items:
- Playwright flows for card + wallet paths
- Nightly run against staging
References: Feature flag rollout

tasks.label: Analytics events
tasks.description:
Problem: funnel dashboards still reference deprecated step names.
Action Items:
- Emit checkout_step_viewed v2 schema
- Backfill mapping for Looker
References: Launch announcement

tasks.label: Launch announcement
tasks.description:
Problem: GTM needs a crisp narrative once rollout completes.
Action Items:
- Draft changelog + blog post
- Coordinate support macros
References: Feature flag rollout

documents.title: Scope: Checkout Revamp
documents.body:
Status: Ready to implement

Replace the monolithic checkout page with a composable flow: cart review, shipping, payment, confirmation.

Success metrics: conversion rate parity at 100% rollout, p95 checkout latency under 2.5s.

documents.title: Design: Payment flow
documents.body:
Status: Ready for review

PaymentIntent created server-side; client confirms with Elements. Webhooks drive order fulfillment state.

documents.title: Investigation: Address validation
documents.body:
Status: Open — requires investigation

Loqate coverage gaps in APAC; fallback to manual entry with server-side normalization.
